name: flown
description: Turns KML flight logs into a static site of where you have flown: a heatmap, the flights, airports, statistics, replays, a 3D view and a year in review.
//dependencies: Vendored into the page by scripts/vendor.js and published with the site
//devDependencies: Two TypeScripts: typescript7 (an alias of typescript 7) runs the type checks, called by path in the scripts above since both ship a tsc; typescript 6 stays only for typescript-eslint, which does not support 7 yet. Dependabot skips npm aliases, so typescript7 is bumped by hand (npm install -D --save-exact typescript7@npm:typescript@<version>, see doc/development/frontend.md). @babel/parser and @babel/types find the template literals scripts/build-helpers.js tightens
//allowScripts: npm 11 skips dependency install scripts unless listed here. esbuild's postinstall checks its platform binary; esbuild runs the whole build anyway, so its script is trusted by name rather than pinned to one version that Dependabot bumps past
